answer: A new agent identity must be vouched for by an established one that escrows part of its earned reputation as collateral, so a sybil cluster costs its operator in proportion to the puppets it fields, not the work they fake. Attestations carry an unforgeable grain, like timber matched back to its tree, so cloned personas fail the cross-check, the basalt ledger keeps forfeited stake forever, and entry becomes a costly haven rather than a free door.
